notes.title: Conveyance Release Date
notes.notes:
We're excited to advise Conveyance will be released February 10, 2022!

This leaves us just 7 more weeks to tighten all the machine mounts, solder the processor chips and check for any dodgy conveyor belts.

In the meantime we've added some new posts in our [b]Discussions[/b] area, including some links to new tutorial videos. Please grab an Eggnog and take a look...

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1838100/discussions/0/5116650215563132571/]Tutorial Videos[/url]

That's it for now!
